sex_ratio_note: Males per 1,000 females in OCHA's COD-PS for this country, reference year 2022, built from the country's official population figures; for a year after the last census, a projection.
religion_note: Religion or creed of the 424,993 people aged 15 or over, as the 2024 census asked it.
language_note: The indigenous language each of the 488,842 people aged 5 or over speaks or understands. The census asks about no other language: the 98.7% who speak or understand none are shown as Spanish, the language nearly all of them speak, which also takes in immigrants whose language is another, Haitian Creole for one.
ethnicity_note: Two questions the 2024 census asked everyone: whether a person is or considers themselves part of an indigenous people, and which; and whether they are Afro-descendant, and how they name it. Someone may answer yes to both, and INE publishes no cross of the two, so the remainder is the population less both counts. It includes the 1,708 who did not answer the Afro-descendant question, and immigrants; the census asks nothing about mestizo or white ancestry.
